title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP06b1 — policy and configuration registry, weaken-policy and head candidate validation
goal: Implement the package policy and configuration part of Plan 06 P4.3 with D24: a registry of editable and trust/meta policy, zero-comparator policy-weakening obligations covered by weaken-policy, head candidate validation from the explicit head commit, report binding to the registry and authorization schema, and removal of the legacy consumption variable.
acceptanceCriteria: shared/policy-config.json registers editable and trust/meta policy with explicit stage files, excludes the authorization directory, never claims derived projection targets, and declares monotonicity for every field of every registered schema; the manifest check enforces all of this.

Every semantic change of a registered file is a policy-weakening obligation covered only by a weaken-policy record with the same blob hashes, head tuple, schema or format and changed pointers; trust/meta changes need change-trusted-base as well, and unregistered policy files fail.

The trusted Diff validates head candidates from Git objects of the explicit head commit: schemas, the head profile, the history manifest against head evidence, derived projections and monotonicity declarations.
The pull request consumes the CP06b1-auth authorization under the CP06a base, and all 13 required checks pass.
